title: SQL Injection Login Bypass
impact: SQL injection can bypass authentication and allow unauthorized administrator access.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and validate authentication inputs.

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
impact: Reflected XSS can execute attacker-controlled JavaScript in a victim browser.
remediation: Use context-aware output encoding and sanitize unsafe HTML.
